card.title: Everything Is Policy
card.instruction: Treat every personal choice as evidence of a larger system. Connect exceptions, habits, and coincidences until they become institutional doctrine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sat beside me at lunch. Shall I record that as our friendship policy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was the only empty chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So friendship is allocated by availability. Useful clarification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow I'll save you a seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We've moved from allocation to a reserved entitlement.

mechanism: A turns an ordinary seat choice and a future favor into progressively formal friendship allocation and entitlement.
confusable: Unlike seeking personal reassurance from a small gesture, A connects the choices into a generalized institutional rule.
comparison: The lunch alternative develops an allocation policy; the tea alternative expands a damage category to absorb an emotional exception.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
